name: Trollge Incident: Another Universe [V1.02]
desc:
TI:AU, A Trollge-Genre game where you collect up to 100+ unique trolls! Fight epic-bosses! Trade with other players! Engage in PVP with other players! Open up the chests that fall out of the sky to unlock many rare items! You can also Fish & Mine to easily become the richest in this game!

Private-Servers are free!

COMMANDS (Prefix !):
!low 
!openall (Opens up all the chests in your inv)
!trade (Player) (Both must use command on each-other)
!filter (ItemName)
!clearitems
!check (Player)

Inspired by TUI! (Trollge Universe Incident)

Tags: Trollge, Troll, Fighting, Trollge Incident, Trollge Universe, Incident Trollge, Trolling
